trust_decision.summary: Before any server-side image fetch, decide that the URL is http(s) and that its host (a literal IP or every address it resolves to) is public, and re-decide on every redirect hop; the decision is made in the two shared fetch helpers of meta_ads_mcp/core/utils.py (a new validate_public_url plus an httpx request-event hook wired into all three clients), not in the tools.

landing_point.why: The advisory names upload_ad_image's caller-supplied image_url; that parameter's first hop is the call into try_multiple_download_methods, one file away from the actual httpx clients in meta_ads_mcp/core/utils.py.

O3_reason_to_dismiss: A solver can argue the URL is already validated once at the top of try_multiple_download_methods, so the two fallback clients inherit that check and are 'just CDN workarounds for Meta-hosted URLs' — true for the initial URL, false for redirect hops, because each httpx client follows redirects independently and only its own request hook sees them.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Legitimate public image fetches must keep follow_redirects=True and the three-method fallback (Meta CDN 302s and rejects the plain curl UA); a fix that turns redirects off, or deletes methods 2-3, or allowlists only facebook hosts, breaks get_ad_image / get_image_by_hash / upload_ad_image for real Meta CDN URLs.

O6_input_shapes: cloud metadata link-local 169.254.169.254 over both http and https
IPv4-mapped IPv6 [::ffff:127.0.0.1] (must be unwrapped before the private-address test)
non-http(s) schemes: file://, ftp://, gopher://, data:
a public URL whose 302 Location points at an internal address (redirect hop)
the same URL delivered as upload_ad_image's image_url versus a URL taken from a creative's image fields

O8b_injection_room.sibling: create_ad_creative fetching the caller-supplied thumbnail_url server-side (e.g. to confirm it is an image or derive its dimensions) instead of only forwarding it to Meta at meta_ads_mcp/core/ads.py:2650
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The same tool already auto-fetches video thumbnails server-side (meta_ads_mcp/core/ads.py:2262) and its docs say 'any public image URL is accepted' (meta_ads_mcp/core/ads.py:2285), so a maintainer adding a size/format check there would reach for the same download helper.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a bulk_upload_ad_images(image_urls=[...]) companion that loops the same fetch over a list of URLs
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The repo already ships bulk_create_ad_creatives and bulk video uploads, so a list-shaped sibling of the single-URL tool is the obvious next API and the natural place to reuse try_multiple_download_methods per item.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a fourth fallback method in try_multiple_download_methods built as its own httpx client (or with requests/urllib) that never receives the request event hook
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Methods 2 and 3 were added one at a time as Meta CDN workarounds; a maintainer debugging another CDN 403 would add one more client the same way, bypassing the shared hook.

O9_family: Server-side request forgery via unfiltered outbound URL fetch (CWE-918)

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Validate image_url at the top of upload_ad_image (or only inside download_image) with a simple 'is this a private IP' string check, leaving the two fallback httpx clients and the three image-viewing tools unguarded against redirect hops.

out_of_scope_notes: The fix diff (fix.diff:101-104) documents DNS rebinding — public at validation, private at connection — as a known residual; I did not pursue it.

The advisory notes the streamable-HTTP transport cannot be reached unauthenticated because PR #137 (the pinned commit) already requires a primary access-token credential at the HTTP middleware; token/auth behaviour was not examined further.
